quarterly_data.quarter: Analog Devices U.S. All Stars Conference 2026 (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Rich Puccio on gross margin: for Q4 ADI has guided to a record margin, and 'the last time we had a record margin, we were a 53% industrial business. We are guiding to this record margin at a 50%' industrial mix. Levers to maintain or raise margin from here: a further mix shift toward industrial (the higher-margin business), better fixed-cost absorption if revenue keeps accelerating, and any potential future price increase, though ADI would prefer costs to moderate.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 guided to a record margin at a 50% industrial mix (prior record at 53% industrial)

quarterly_data.quarter: Analog Devices U.S. All Stars Conference 2026 (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Rich Puccio on automotive: despite a relatively soft units environment, 'over the last five years, we've outgrown units by about 15%', largely on share and content gains from early investments in automated driving systems and the immersive cabin experience. After about a year and a half of inventory work-off in the VSM piece of the auto business, 'we actually think that that business will come back to growth in the current year.'
quarterly_data.figure: outgrew auto units by about 15% over the last five years; VSM auto expected back to growth this year

quarterly_data.quarter: Analog Devices U.S. All Stars Conference 2026 (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Rich Puccio on the broad (mass) market, hedged ('Jeff will correct me if I'm wrong'): 'the broad market's probably about 15% of industrial' and on average above the corporate gross margin average; many large customers also buy through it. If Q4 lands where ADI expects, 'that will be four quarters of where we've seen broad market growth' - still much shorter than a typical cycle.
quarterly_data.figure: broad market about 15% of industrial, above corporate average gross margin; four quarters of broad-market growth if Q4 lands as expected
